question: Team ES2008 wanted a feature to stop the remote getting lost. What happened to that feature, who raised the main objection to it, and what was the objection?

steps.answer: The anti-loss/remote-finder feature (proposed by A in meeting 2, since 50% of users cited losing remotes as their top frustration) was ultimately dropped in the final meeting (ES2008d). The main objection came from C (UI designer), who argued it was technologically impractical since a lost remote under furniture couldn't receive an infrared signal to trigger a beep.

steps.answer: The anti-loss/finder feature was proposed in meeting 2 (ES2008b) but ultimately dropped in the final meeting (ES2008d). Speaker C (UI designer) raised the main objection: it's technologically impractical since a lost remote is likely under a couch cushion, so no infrared signal could reach it, calling it possibly just a gimmick.
